## Keywords

{{< glossary ai-assistant generative-ai training-data hallucination knowledge-cutoff ai-bias search-engine >}}

## 2.1 What AI does well

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An AI assistant learned from a huge amount of text and writes likely words.
- It writes drafts, summaries and ideas in seconds.
- It can also rewrite a text or translate it, and you check every answer.
- **Lab task:** Ask an AI for 5 trip ideas and a summary of a paragraph. Which idea is best?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/ai-good-jobs.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Good jobs for AI

a) Which good job for AI is the prompt "Give me the main points of this 3-page report"?
b) Which good job for AI is the prompt "Make this e-mail shorter and more polite"?
c) What can happen when you ask the same prompt the next day?

::: {.answer}
a) a summary
b) a rewrite
c) The AI can give a different answer.
:::

## 2.2 Five weak spots of AI answers

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- AI can invent facts, books and links: this is a hallucination.
- It can give old information, wrong numbers or unfair ideas (bias).
- It does not know your situation unless you tell it.
- **Lab task:** Ask an AI for 3 books about Excel. Do the books exist?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/ai-weak-spots.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/weak-spots.html" poster="sims/weak-spots.png" title="Weak Spots: what is wrong with this AI answer?" task="**Show:** read the AI answer and the line What you know. **Ask:** which of the five weak spots is it?" >}}

## Try it 2 · Which weak spot?

a) The AI says that 12 pens at 0.25 JD cost 3.50 JD. Which weak spot is it?
b) It is 2026, and the AI says that the newest app version is from 2021. Which weak spot is it?
c) What do we call an answer that sounds sure but is invented?

::: {.answer}
a) a wrong number (12 × 0.25 = 3.00 JD)
b) old information
c) a hallucination
:::

## 2.3 AI, search engine or spreadsheet?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An AI assistant is best for drafts, summaries, ideas and translations.
- A search engine finds today's facts, dates and rules on the real website.
- A spreadsheet gives exact sums and averages.
- **Lab task:** Find the library hours with AI and on the university website. Which answer do you trust?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/tool-choice.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/right-tool.html" poster="sims/right-tool.png" title="Right Tool: AI, search or spreadsheet?" task="**Show:** read each job and choose a tool. **Ask:** why is this tool better than the other two?" >}}

## Try it 3 · Which tool?

a) Which tool is best for the last day to apply for a scholarship?
b) Which tool is best for the average of 30 test marks?
c) What are the five steps when you use AI?

::: {.answer}
a) a search engine, then the official website
b) a spreadsheet
c) ask, read, check, edit, use
:::

## Game challenge · Omar's newsletter

{{< sim file="sims/newsletter.html" poster="sims/newsletter.png" title="Newsletter Check" kind="game" task="**The story:** an AI wrote Sunrise Company's October newsletter. **Your task:** check each sentence against the company records, fix the three mistakes and publish." >}}

## Try it 4 · Omar's newsletter (harder)

The facts: sales were 3 500 JD in September and 4 200 JD in October. The shop is open Saturday to Thursday. The company won no awards.

a) The AI writes "a rise of 1 200 JD". What is the real rise?
b) Which weak spot is the AI sentence "We won the Best Shop award in 2025"?
c) Why is the AI sentence "The shop is open every day" wrong?

::: {.answer}
a) 700 JD
b) an invented fact (a hallucination)
c) The shop is closed on Friday.
:::

## Summary

- Generative AI learned from training data and writes likely words.
- AI writes drafts, summaries, ideas, rewrites and translations very fast.
- AI answers can have invented facts, old information, wrong numbers, bias or missing context.
- Use AI for drafts, a search engine for facts and a spreadsheet for numbers.
- With AI, you ask, read, check, edit and use, and you are responsible for the result.
